WhatWeDo.Title: Small grants. Local hands. Visible change.
WhatWeDo.Description: IFundAyiti moves practical capital to Haitian entrepreneurs and community builders — without equity, and without tying a gift to one applicant.
WhatWeDo.Quote: Donations fund the program. Grants fund the work.

HowItWorks.Title: Five steps from idea to impact
HowItWorks.Subtitle: A grant lifecycle designed so applicants always know what happens next.
HowItWorks.Step1Body: Submit your idea and the required information during an open grant cycle.
HowItWorks.Step2Body: The IFundAyiti team reviews applications for completeness, feasibility, and community impact.
HowItWorks.Step3Body: Outstanding approved applicants become finalists for the current cycle.
HowItWorks.Step4Body: One finalist is selected as the winner and receives grant funding.
HowItWorks.Step5Body: Funding helps turn the idea into real-world impact in Haitian communities.
